name: marketing-frameworks
description: Marketing frameworks, paid ads metrics and playbooks for websites, marketing plans, social media and paid ads.

interface.shortDescription: Website audits, marketing plans, social calendars and paid ads using proven frameworks.
interface.longDescription: Applies 10 marketing frameworks (STP, 4 Ps, RACE, decoy effect, brand resonance pyramid, theory of planned behavior and more) and 15 paid-media metrics (ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, Conversions API) to real work: landing page and pricing page audits, marketing plans, social media calendars and Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Every framework carries an honest evidence rating and the skill never invents benchmarks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit my landing page and pricing page for conversion and give me a prioritised fix list.
